identity.all_routes: exact normalized distinctive original title or explicit source translation; nonempty source and original year within 1; original full personal author exact normalized or exact full-name token set; nonempty DOI/PMID conflicts reject
identity.xml: must be confirmed published PMC metadata, explicit author xref or nested aff association, no sole-aff fallback
identity.pdf: same identity; year must equal original for nonpublished/unknown version; publishedVersion permits online/print +/-1

country.evidence: only linked author affiliation direct country element or exact terminal country alias; no references, journal country, publisher/HQ, free city/name inference
country.aliases: old country-review-v1 aliases plus XML UK/U.K.; snapshot country dictionary
country.ambiguous_affiliations: withhold that affiliation; other independent unambiguous author evidence may remain
country.visible_completeness: reported separately; no claim every coauthor country observed

discovery.ambiguous_pmc_mappings: if identifier/linkage points to multiple PMCID, defer rather than choose first
discovery.inventory_scope: frozen official 2026-11-11 Cloud metadata inventory, not all possible publishers

validation_cohort.eligible: baseline UNKNOWN in fixed original Q, unique DOI/PMID to PMCID, present in frozen official PMC OA inventory; all pilot/development IDs excluded
validation_cohort.candidate_audit: validation agent bottom128 of original automatic positives; failures/unknown never replaced
validation_cohort.candidate_gate: at least128; point>=99%; two-sided95%Wilson lower>=97%; no unisolated systemic mismatch
validation_cohort.pdf: new independent probability holdout, second stage max8 per original stratum; freeze ids/pi2 before fetch; insufficiency does not trigger unlimited further crawling
